definition.name: Linux frontend and maintained tutorial execution

steps.name: Install exact hashed Linux frontend build inputs
Build native Linux frontend and observe redistributed libraries
Build native production component execution host
Assemble Linux frontend and portable host with the shared distribution owner
steps.run:
python -c "from pathlib import Path; import shutil,subprocess; from tools.dev_distribution import file_digest; from tools.dev_workflow.common import encode; d=Path('target/dev-linux-frontend/portable'); d.mkdir(); p=d/'latent-portable-test-host'; shutil.copyfile('target/release/latent-portable-test-host',p); p.with_suffix('.json').write_bytes(encode({'sourceCommit':subprocess.check_output(['git','rev-parse','HEAD'],text=True).strip(),'sha256':file_digest(p)[0],'target':'linux-x86_64','profile':'release'}))"
python tools/build_dev_bundle.py --target linux-x86_64 --frontend target/dev-linux-frontend --portable target/dev-linux-frontend/portable/latent-portable-test-host --output target/dev-linux

steps.name: Execute all maintained tutorial applications on Linux
steps.run:
set -euo pipefail
for language in rust c java dotnet go typescript; do
  python tools/run_portable_guest_tests.py --host target/release/latent-portable-test-host --language "$language" --applications "target/dev-applications/developer-$language-applications-$GITHUB_SHA" --output "target/dev-portable-$language-applications.json"
done
